title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: This ACS funded project strengthened cholera prevention and response efforts in Bahir Dar and Gondar cities through capacity building, community engagement, and WASH interventions. It provided training for health workers and health extension workers (HEWs) on cholera case management and prevention, implemented extensive social and behaviour change activities, distributed essential WASH NFIs to vulnerable households, and disinfected water sources to ensure safe and sustainable access to clean water.. Marker 3.3 was selected due to the primary objective of the response being strengthened cholera prevention and response efforts in Bahir Dar and Gondar cities through capacity building, community engagement, and WASH interventions. Concern worked with health extension workers and communities to undertand cholera prevention better and to promote reduced incidences of cholera through improved water and sanitation, behavious change and treatment.
